nom: ANUA Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream

avis.texte: UGH i love anua so i was soooo excited to try this product. I've been using it for a month now, and the only difference I see after use is redness. It doesn't help with puffiness at all :/ in fact, i feel like my eyes have been even more puffy recently in the mornings and I'm just now realizing it may be the cream. Only giving it two stars bc of applicator and packaging

Every other aspect of this product is great. I love the applicator, it feels very luxe and cooling, and my dry eyes loved this upon first application. However, every time I've used this, I've woken up with an itchy red undereye area. Anyone who has sensitive eyes, be careful.

avis.titre: Cooling and non-irritating for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Loving this product right now! It goes on smoothly and blends flawlessly into my skin. It doesn't merely sit on the surface but truly absorbs well. The applicator tip feels cool and soothing on what can only be described as "tired mom eyes" in the mornings. There is zero odor to the product and I have not had any irritation to my skin and I have VERY sensitive skin especially on my face. It doesn't magically erase my eye bags but it sure feels wonderful!

I really like this eye cream! The silver applicator feels cool and soothing under my eyes, especially in the morning. The cream is lightweight, blends in easily, and doesn't feel heavy or greasy. The packaging also feels very well made. I would definitely recommend it.
Use it daily, has helped with not only the fine lines and wrinkles but I've noticed a huge difference in my hooded eyelids. I recommend this stuff to everyone now.
My dark circles got lighter with 1 week of using it every other day. definitely worth it.

I have noticed the skin around my eyes looking really dry after using this product. The skin has not turned brighter, in fact, it looks darker and irritated from the eye cream. Theres a burning sensation when i put it on now. Not sure if its because of how dry my skin is. Makeup doesnt look good. It makes the dryness more obvious.

I have been using this eye cream for about 5 months now and I am very satisfied on the results. I have very sensitive skin and I have used other retinol products around my eyes and had a very bad reaction to it but not this one. I put it on over my face moisturizer and under my concealer and no it does no smudge my make up. It has brighten and it has reduced the creases around my eyes.

I went into this product very open minded and i did not see results. I use it every night until i ran out of the product, it did last me about 2 months. However i didnt notice any changes to my under eye cirles getting brighter, my fine likes are still there.

I've used this product for about 3-4 months now. I use it twice a day, and nothing about my under eyes have changed. I still have the same fine lines. I love anua and rave about all their products but this one isn't it.
This is a great price and quantity but it's not moisturizing enough. I have to reapply after 4 hours but its still not enough mositure for me. It doesn't pill under makeup which is a plus.
This product does not work. I will stick with the less expensive Cereve eye cream which actually reduces eye puffiness and fine lines

avis.titre: Anua retinol 0.1 caffeine revitalizing ese cream
avis.texte: Since I started using the Anua Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream, my appearance has improved incredibly. I love this cream.

I recently started using this Anua retinol 0.1 caffeine revitalizing eye cream. The cream has a lightweight texture and absorbs quickly into the skin. I've noticed it provides good hydration around my eyes, and it feels gentle. While it's still early, I haven't seen a dramatic reduction in dark circles, but the area looks a bit more refreshed. It's a promising eye cream for those wanting a mild retinol product.

I've been very happy with the many Anua products I have tried so far. So I am not surprised that I liked this one a lot too. It's a very nice silky hydrating eye cream. My under eye area in particular looked less puffy the mornings after I have used this, and I think the dark circles under my eyes were less pronounced too, on days when I was a little more tired. It's a decently sized tube too.
Made a difference already! My under eyes look brighter and less dull. It looks like I got sleep. It's a smooth, moisturizing formula that's not greasy or heavy and it absorbs well.

High quality eye cream, it?셲 not too thick but not runny at all, is an off yellow color with a slight scent.. nothing too bothersome. The ingredients of retinol and caffeine help the skin around the eyes ?쐗ake up?? I haven?셳 gotten any adverse reactions, so I?셫 very pleased with how hydrated and moisturized the skin is.

Great lightweight cream. It?셲 yellow in color, unscented, and absorbs easily into the skin. The first night I put it on under my eyes I noticed a difference in the morning. They were hydrated and the fine lines looked less crepe-like, although still there. After continued use a couple of times a week I can see an improvement overall. Directions say you can use all over your face on whatever spots you would like, which is interesting, I have just chosen my eyes for now and am happy with the improvement.

Not greasy and doesn't creep into my eye and irritate. I don't use it every night, maybe 3 nights a week when I do a retinol product on my entire face. It does leave my under-eye area feeling hydrated. I also dot it around my mouth on the "laugh line" area. I haven't been using it long enough to notice any improvement but it does feel light and hydrating on my skin.

This Anua retinol caffeine revitalizing eye cream is nice. It has a thick but lightweight consistency that doesn't leave any heavy, sticky or greasy feeling behind. The cream doesn't have any noticeable scent and it's gentle on my skin.

I deal with dark circles and dull skin under my eyes so I thought I would give this cream a shot since I trust the Anua brand.A tiny dot is all I need and it absorbs well without any greasy residue or heavy scents. I have sensitive skin and this doesn?셳 irritate it at all!It seems to moisturize and brighten under my eyes well and even though it is a tiny tube, since a little bit is all you need, I see this lasting me a long time.So far, I am pleased with the results and plan to actually purchase another when I run out!

Anua is a great brand and this product is no exception. This eye cream has two great ingredients - retinol and caffeine, which is an interesting combination. I usually use retinol at night and caffeine in the morning, but with this product, I use it at night because of the retinol. The consistency is slightly thick and gel like, but still feels very lightweight on the skin. It applies nicely and layers well with other skin care products. It doesn't really have any fragrance and I didn't experience any irritation. This product leaves my eyes feeling very well hydrated and decreases some of my fine lines. I would recommend this product.

My biggest issue with my skincare is always ignoring my eye area. I did a skin test recently and was told I needed to focus and get a good eye cream since I always have discoloration under my eyes. This Anua Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Eye Cream helps with the dark discoloration and slight lines under my eyes. I've noticed that using it pretty consistently has helped my eye a lot. If you are looking for a good eye cream to boost up your skincare here is a reliable one.

This eye cream is very nice. It is a nice consistency and I only require maybe half of a pea size for my eyes. I use it at night and it is soothing. I have not found it to be irritating to the sensitive skin under my eyes at all. There is no noticeable fragrance or scents noted. The product is nice and it seems to help with hydrating and reducing the dark circles under my eyes but I cannot attest to long term use at this time. I like this product and will continue to use it.

This eye cream is unscented and has a nice consistency - thick and creamy. It's slightly greasy feeling at first, but absorbs well, leaving a little bit of a tacky/firming sensation. This is definitely more of a cream (as described) vs. a serum. It has a good texture. Looking forward to seeing what it does over time!

I'm sad to admit that I really need "revitalizing" eye cream - but I'm always hesitant to use it, because I don't want to risk eye irritation. This Anua retinol + caffeeine cream was gentle on my skin (while still feeling like it's working!). It doesn't have much of a scent.The 1.05 oz tube has a good amount in it, and it spread well (I didn't need to use much). The box says that this tube received in Feb. 2025 expires in Oct. 2026 while the tube recommends using in 8 months.

This eye cream is good quality. Moisturizes the area around the very well. Absorbs quickly. Fragrance free.

avis.titre: Non-sticky and feels safe on my skin
avis.texte: This Anua Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream absorbs quickly, is non-sticky and feels safe on my skin. It's fragrance-free, which is a plus. The size is adequate and it should last a while. The packaging is well-designed, with product information available in both Korean and English. After looking for a skincare product that offers multiple benefits, this one matches what I'm looking for. I will need a few more weeks to see the full results. So far, I'm satisfied.
I really like this Retinol. It?셲 easy to apply, you don?셳 need a lot and it is moisturizing. I have been using this every night

avis.titre: Anua Eye Cream - Revitalizing and Smoothing
avis.texte: This Anua Retinol and Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream comes in a tube that you squeeze to get the cream out of the tube. The opening is small so it is easy to dot the cream under the eyes and then pat it into the skin. It's thick and it covers the skin and is quickly absorbed leaving my skin feeling smooth and revitalized. Recommended to start out every other day if you are new to retinol. I really like this product and how it feels on my skin and its effects. Another nice Korean skincare product.

avis.titre: Seems Like a Nice Eye Cream, Good Initial Results
avis.texte: This Anua Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream Goes on well and does not irritate my eyes. This is a lightweight cream. I thought it did slightly improve my undereye area look, although I've never really had a caffeine cream do much for my eye area. I think that different people have different reasons for looking weary around their eyes and different ingredients address different causes. I've yet to discover mine, perhaps I simply AM weary! But I will say this cream has seemed to have the most potential so far for me. I'm excited to see if it does help me look "brighter". I'm very cautious about eye creams, so finding one like this that I actually feel comfortable using is a wonderful discovery for me! This eye cream is made in Korea.

This works!It doesn't irritate me at all, I don't need all that much at all either so this is going to last a while. It soaks into the skin area fast, there's no scent far as I can tell, it doesn't feel like I smeared grease all over the place and it moisturizes like few others I've tried haveThis is excellent and well worth it!

The Anua Retinol 0.1 Caffeine Revitalizing Eye Cream is a light cream to rejuvenate tired eyes. The cream is fragrance-free and absorbs quickly. I didn't notice a big difference with the first application. But it feels nice under my eyes and gives nice hydration. I've been impressed by other Anua products, so I wanted to give this a try. It seems good quality. I had no adverse reactions to my sensitive skin, so that's a plus. Overall, it's a nice product.

avis.titre: a nice eye treatment with caffeine
avis.texte: I like this brand very much and am excited to try their eye retinol. I'm very glad it has caffeine in it, which I'm hoping will work to minimize my dark circles. The cream is very light and absorbs quickly. I haven't had any irritation so far. The list of ingredients is excellent, and I recommend this for people who aren't able to use tretinoin around their eyes.

Burns a little. I can feel the skin tightening. It really does work. I'm disappointed in the small tube. It's not going to last very long. Please check for yourself the amount in ounces and compare that to the price and you have to decide for yourself whether it is worth it for you or not. I cannot make that decision for you. What I will say is that it does indeed work as described. Thank you.

avis.titre: gentle-feeling retinol with no sticky or greasy texture and
avis.texte: I've tried so many retinol products, and a lot of them miss the mark. This one is the perfect combination of fragrance-free, almost texture-free, gentle treatment.First of all, it absorbed right away and didn't leave behind any shiny, sticky, or greasy film. Second, I noticed no fragrance which is a plus for me, especially close to my eyes. Finally, I didn't experience any dry patches or flaking in the following days. To add to that, it is definitely less costly than similar products. The tube is small, but a little bit goes a long way, so it will last a while. I'm glad to add this to my rotation of eye treatments.

It goes on smoothly, absorbs well, and leaves no residue. It is hydrating and refreshing. I can?셳 report on the results until further use, so I will update this review after extended usage.

I use retinol on my face, but avoid the eye area as I can't tolerate it there. This product, though, does not irritate my eyes and absorbs quickly into the skin. Leaves eye area looking better through the instant hydration, and hopefully with time, will help reduce the finer lines there.
